issue.title: New Project create collision test leaves Review enabled under Master Gate, passes locally
issue.description:
Found by the lander for sase-1lh.7.5.4.3.3.4 while auditing watch phase .3 note #2 (MASTER_GATE_RED), on sase master 933970ce72a5b5328499e80751a491c857bfc221.

Master Gate 39077497974 fails tests/ace/tui/modals/test_new_project_create_flow.py::test_name_collision_blocks_review_but_occupied_checkout_surfaces on both attempt 1 and attempt 2. At line 234, the create Review button is enabled when it must be disabled for the duplicate project name existing-project. The test sets the repository name to brandnew and the project name to existing-project without yielding between those edits, then pauses 0.8s. Both CI runs use Python 3.12.15 and xdist.

The exact node passes locally on the identical unchanged source SHA as part of a focused ten-test run, ToolRun ea71a0a3feee0de027d98bfdd22a332a (10 passed in 42.78s). The local interpreter is Python 3.14, so this is evidence of environment/load sensitivity, not a claim that the environments match. Observed 2 CI failures and 1 local pass; no general failure rate or repeated serial failure claimed.

Read the real widget and fixture before changing timing. NewProjectCreateConfigure.on_input_changed queues separate events; repository-name normalization invokes _sync_project_inputs, while explicit project-name edits set project_name_edited. Off-thread form and availability work also repaints drafts. Investigate whether the fixture edits outrun stage readiness or queued name-follow behavior, whether a stale repaint loses the explicit project name, and whether the installed/pinned core changes the verdict. Preserve the duplicate-name assertion and real debounce. Do not simply lengthen the pause, skip the node, or weaken collision rejection.

This is distinct from sase-1m9 (add/configure Review stays disabled after a single edit; known 0.4s preview readiness race) and sase-1l8 (visual create-check never settles within 15s). Link both as adjacent ownership, without assuming their root causes are identical. No exact duplicate in all-status searches or last-week task sweep. New Project epic sase-1jx is closed. No causal link to an active epic established; active global-state leak epic sase-j7 is only topical until a leak is demonstrated. This release epic changed mode_t and launch timestamp fixtures, not this test or its implementation. Root cause is unproven, so large is intentional.

CI: https://github.com/sase-org/sase/actions/runs/39077497974
Local command: SASE_PYTEST_WORKERS=1 sase tool run -- .venv/bin/python tools/run_pytest fast -q tests/ace/tui/modals/test_new_project_create_flow.py::test_name_collision_blocks_review_but_occupied_checkout_surfaces tests/test_axe_run_agent_runner_deferred_workspace_flow.py tests/test_agent_artifact_directory_operation_audit.py
